_comment: CLAUDE.md size ratchet CEILING (W1-T503, MASTER-PLAN §8A). Captured via `node scripts/claude-md-budget-ratchet.mjs` against the committed CLAUDE.md. UNLIKE scripts/learnings-budget-baseline.json, capBytes carries ZERO HEADROOM over the measured figure -- CLAUDE.md's own charter says every addition must be paid for by a fold ('compression is a deliverable, not just accretion'), so growth without compression is exactly what this ratchet is meant to make visible. Never raise this to paper over an unreviewed dump of new rules -- raising the cap is a deliberate, reviewed change (like the coverage floor and the learnings cap); a PR that grows CLAUDE.md past it must go CI-red on scripts/claude-md-budget-ratchet.mjs until the same PR folds, sharpens, or deletes something to pay for the growth, or a reviewed cap bump says why growth is right this time.
bumpRationale: Raised 62644 -> 62733 by W1-T1113. THE GROWTH IS A MISSING CAVEAT, NOT A DUMP: the max-id bullet's numeric-tail recipe (`grep -oE 'T[0-9]+'`) is minting-only, but nothing warned that reusing it for duplicate detection truncates the 21 letter-suffixed ids the plan carries down to their numeric stems, manufacturing eight phantom collisions -- measured via `grep -c '^- id: W1-T[0-9]*[A-Za-z]' plan/tasks.yaml` returning 21 at head. The same bullet (CLAUDE.md lines 240-246) now marks the numeric form MINTING-ONLY and gives the whole-token `sort | uniq -d` form for duplicate detection instead. AND IT WAS PART-PAID BY A FOLD: the bullet's own citation line shrank from 90 to 67 bytes ('#770 -- renumbered to W1-T257; #775 -- to W1-T261; same collision twice in one session' to '#770/#775 renumbered to W1-T257/W1-T261 -- same collision twice'), so the raw addition of 107 bytes (bullet measured 471 -> 578 bytes) reaches the file as a net +89. No other bullet was touched. Zero headroom is preserved -- capBytes == measuredBytes, the invariant test/claude-md-budget-ratchet.test.ts pins.
